furnitureBriefTemplate.note: Dipakai tools/derive_briefs_from_layout.py: satu sheet = 4-6 item dari satu ruang/kelas slot yang sama. Ukuran, kelas, dan arah diambil dari slot di layout; JANGAN menebak.
furnitureBriefTemplate.promptPerSheet: [STYLE BLOCK] Furniture sprite sheet for {roomLabel}. Items left to right: {itemList with exact sizes in px and role}. Every item is front-facing (facing the camera), top-down 3/4 RPG view, drawn as ONE separate object with a flat straight base along its bottom edge, no walls, no floor, no surrounding room. {moduleRule} Items are drawn at consistent real-world scale relative to each other with the same visible pixel size. All screens, labels, frames and book spines blank or abstract. Flat solid magenta #FF00FF background, no shadows on the background. Match the art style, pixel size, outline weight and palette of the reference image exactly. [NEGATIVE BLOCK]
furnitureBriefTemplate.moduleRule_counter: These are kitchen counter MODULES that must butt together into one continuous row: identical total height, identical top-surface level and base line, plain flat vertical cut on the left and right edges, no side panels, same wood and cream materials.
furnitureBriefTemplate.itemListFormat: name (W x H px, role: wall_back|counter_module|free|cluster)
furnitureBriefTemplate.qa: skala seragam per sheet; tiap item ±20% dari ukuran slot; modul counter: tinggi identik (±2 px) dan sisi kiri/kanan datar; dasar rata baris terbawah
